Maya (VP Eng): Great Q&A today — dropping a short thread for follow-ups and owners.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Kernel rollout summary: weekly canaries for incremental changes, full rollout windows monthly. First canary for kernel-y starts next Thursday, initial traffic 1%.
Console-bot: Canary scheduled: id=canary-214567, start=2026-04-22T16:00:00Z, traffic=1%.
Priya (ML Eng): Request: publish per-model perf buckets (short/mid/long) so PMs can surface in docs.
Maya (VP Eng): Agreed — targets set: short <=1k p95<=100ms, mid 1k-6k p95<=300ms, long >6k p95<=600ms. We'll add to SLA appendix.
Sam (SRE): Observability asks: add kernel_tag, batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate to per-route dashboards. Alert if p95 exceeds SLA for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
Jana (SRE): Canary rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback on p95 increase >6% OR error-rate delta >3% OR any new OOM. Also require smoke tests pass before expansion.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Batching change: default dynamic batch token cap moves 8->12 for most gen models; expose `max_batch_tokens` + `batch_timeout_ms` per model. We'll route cold long-context to low-batch lanes.
Priya (ML Eng): Action: Priya+Ravi to produce a short quantization note (4-bit vs 8-bit) with quality/latency tradeoffs. Due Tue EOD.
Maya (VP Eng): Console team to add a small banner during canaries: "Runtime canary in progress — small % of requests may see variant routing".
Console-bot: UI ticket created: ui-4012, assignee=Console Team, due=2026-04-21.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): I'll open the batching PR and post the perf matrix link here.
Maya (VP Eng): Thanks all — I'll send calendar events for check-ins. If new action items surface, drop them here so we keep a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
